output.subject: Invoice INV A2207: duplicate of INV-A-2207
output.body:
Hello Acme Office Supplies team,

We received a scanned copy of invoice INV A2207 for USD 4,779.24. It matches invoice INV-A-2207, dated 2 October 2026, which we have already received for the same amount, so we have closed this copy as a duplicate.

If it was sent twice by mistake, no action is needed. If it is a different charge, please reply with a corrected invoice that has its own number.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Demo Co.
